Chunk 1 resolves in-chunk: 'that list' (line 15) -> the tool list requested lines 11/13; 'this session' (lines 11, 13, and inside the expanded line-17 prompt) is the student's own live-session deixis; 'the same set' and 'the list you gave me earlier' (inside the expanded line-17 prompt, confirmed via `node scripts/expand-md.js curriculum/lectures/the-agent-loop.md`) resolve to the tool list Claude's own reply will just have produced. Chunk 2 resolves in-chunk: 'that iteration' (line 24) -> 'each iteration' (line 22); 'this same loop' (line 25, current text: 'A long-running session is this same loop, iterated. The loop keeps choosing the next step from context and tool results, hour after hour.') -> 'the agent loop' just named (line 24). Name the harness, the LLM, the tool-call step, and how tool results feed back to the LLM.') uses 'the harness' one slide before its own bolded definition at line 23 -- forward reference in raw-file order. Filed as a rule-question in `notes`, not a REVISE.
